claim: No statement about zeros of zeta. Hecke amplifier of length N above the truncation height T on the truncated Eisenstein series E*(z, rho/2). PROVED: T_m on the truncated series is lambda(m) f minus pseudo-Eisenstein series cut at heights Td/a; the coset c enters the pairing of cuts h_i, h_j iff c^2 h_i h_j < 1; closed Gram formula for all T, N (checked against quadrature to 1e-14). MEASURED (arb balls): optimal gain below N^delta in all 132 registered zero cells (T in {1,2,4}, N up to 32T; max 0.9919), in 844 rows at zeros 1-300 and 463 formal rows with delta down to 0.01; crossing terms change the gain by a factor in [0.987, 1.0094]. EIS-w exceeds N^delta in 394 of 528 rows and obeys the same general comparator MS(T)/MS(T/N). Lower side: registered prediction R2 <= 1 FAILED for T < N (sup R2 up to 1.46 at N <= 8); PROVED cap R2 <= M/L = 1/(1 - S/M); EIS-w shows the same excess. Constants only; no stage-A candidate recommended.
